title: Ridgeline Tool Rental Return Fee Schedule
content:
Fee schedule applied by Ridgeline Tool Rental rental centers to returned equipment, by equipment class.

| Equipment class | Cleaning fee, USD | Charge per accessory not returned, USD | Shop labor rate, USD per hour | Refuelling price per eighth of a tank, USD | Refuelling service fee, USD |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Rental Hand and Power Tools | 15.00 | 10.00 | 65.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Ridgeline Rental Floor and Surface Care | 35.00 | 15.00 | 65.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Ridgeline Rental Lawn and Landscape | 25.00 | 20.00 | 75.00 | 6.50 | 5.00 |
| Ridgeline Rental Concrete and Masonry | 45.00 | 25.00 | 85.00 | 6.50 | 5.00 |
| Ridgeline Rental Aerial and Lifting | 25.00 | 40.00 | 110.00 | 9.00 | 10.00 |
| Ridgeline Rental Earthmoving and Compact Equipment | 75.00 | 60.00 | 125.00 | 18.00 | 15.00 |

## What each column means

- **Cleaning fee**: the fee when equipment comes back needing cleaning beyond normal use.
- **Charge per accessory not returned**: the class charge for each accessory (blade, bit, hose, pad) that does not come back.
- **Shop labor rate**: the hourly rate at which the rental center's shop assesses the repair of damage, parts being added to the labor.
- **Refuelling price per eighth**: the price per eighth of a tank below the fuel level at checkout.
- **Refuelling service fee**: the class service fee that goes with a refuelling charge.

Hand and power tools and floor and surface care equipment show 0.00 for both refuelling columns.

## Hypothetical illustration

A repair of 3 shop hours plus 40.00 of parts on a Ridgeline Rental Concrete and Masonry unit is assessed at 3 hours at 85.00, that is 255.00, plus 40.00 of parts: 295.00. The hours and the parts are illustrative inputs only.
